zxing.min.js is @zxing/library 0.21.3 (Apache-2.0, license in zxing-LICENSE.txt), unmodified from the npm package file umd/index.min.js.
It reads barcodes from photos and the camera in the app (app-v2/mobile.js), and is loaded only when someone opens barcode search.
Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zxing/library/v/0.21.3
